_comment: Curated named climate events and documented analogue ground impact chronicles for the Kenya ENSO Explorer v3 annotation layer (KE-54 / KE-57). Editorial metadata and authoritative ground observations synthesized from Kenya Food Security Steering Group (KFSSG), National Drought Management Authority (NDMA), and Kenya Meteorological Department (KMD) records. No hand-typed numeric data claims; event windows align with empirical driver indices and verified multi-agency assessment reports conforming to copyright posture D62 (Tiers A & B).

blurb.en: A major Pacific El Niño driving unusually heavy short rains across much of Kenya, initiating substantial pastoral pasture flushes alongside localized riverine deluges.

impact_record.crop_stage_ond: Torrential short rains interrupted drying and storage of long-rains maize in Western grain basket counties (Trans Nzoia, Uasin Gishu), while triggering high germination and early vegetative flush for short-rains pulses and cereals across Eastern and Central lowlands.
impact_record.pasture_livestock: Rapid rejuvenation of rangeland biomass and open water pans across northern pastoral rangelands; high pasture flush offset early dry-season forage deficits, though localized foot-rot and vector surges were reported.
impact_record.flood_infrastructure: Extensive riverine overtopping along Lower Tana and Nyando basins; washouts of rural earthen roads and culverts in low-lying ASAL districts.
impact_record.disaster_response: Government emergency grain distributions and logistical mobilizations coordinated through provincial disaster committees and Kenya Red Cross Society.
impact_record.documentary_sources: Kenya Meteorological Department (KMD) Historical Weather Archive; Ministry of Agriculture Crop Situation Reports 1982/83.

label.fr: Super El Niño et IOD positif de 1997-1998

blurb.en: The strongest El Niño on historical record paired with a powerful positive Indian Ocean Dipole — extreme short rains and widespread catastrophic flooding that remains Kenya's primary flood benchmark.

impact_record.impact_class: Catastrophic National Flood Disaster & Epic Fluvial Inundation
impact_record.crop_stage_ond: Unprecedented continuous rains caused catastrophic waterlogging and fungal spoilage on mature long-rains maize crops in Western Kenya. In Eastern ASALs, intense deluges washed away topsoil, seedbeds, and young emerging seedlings, destroying early cropping efforts.
impact_record.pasture_livestock: Pastoral rangelands turned into impassable mud swamps. Severe hypothermia, foot-rot, and catastrophic outbreaks of Rift Valley Fever (RVF) and contagious caprine pleuropneumonia (CCPP) caused massive livestock mortality across Garissa, Wajir, and Marsabit.
impact_record.flood_infrastructure: Epic riverine breaches across all major basins: Nyando River submerged the entire Kano Plains; Nzoia River breached Budalang'i dykes; Tana River burst banks flooding Garissa town and Hola; Daua River overflowed in Mandera. The A2 Nairobi–Moyale highway, B8 Coastal highway, and Mombasa–Nairobi transport corridor suffered catastrophic structural washouts, isolating entire provinces.
impact_record.disaster_response: Declaration of a National Disaster; massive international air-lift operations coordinated by the National Disaster Operations Centre (NDOC), UN OCHA, WFP, and KRCS delivering emergency medical supplies, water purification kits, and high-energy biscuits.
impact_record.documentary_sources: Kenya Meteorological Department (KMD) 1997/98 El Niño Technical Review; UN OCHA Flash Appeal Situation Reports; KFSSG Post-Flood Recovery Archives.

blurb.en: Persistent equatorial Pacific cooling produced back-to-back failed rainy seasons, triggering acute agricultural crop failures, livestock collapse, and national hydropower rationing.

impact_record.crop_stage_ond: Back-to-back rainfall failure crippled both the 1999 Short Rains planting in Eastern Kenya and the 2000 Long Rains harvest across the Rift Valley and Central provinces, causing nationwide staple maize shortages and sharp grain price inflation.
impact_record.pasture_livestock: Severe depletion of pasture browse across Kajiado, Turkana, Marsabit, and Samburu; pastoralist distress migrations across international borders; widespread emaciation and commercial livestock liquidation.
impact_record.flood_infrastructure: Zero fluvial flooding; severe hydrological drought caused Masinga and Ndakaini reservoirs to drop to historic low levels, triggering nationwide electricity load-shedding and municipal water rationing.
impact_record.disaster_response: National Emergency Declaration; large-scale emergency relief food operations under the Special Relief Programme, with early UN WFP emergency food airlifts and community water trucking.
impact_record.documentary_sources: Kenya Meteorological Department (KMD) National Drought Review 2000; WFP Emergency Operation (EMOP 6274) Bulletins; KFSSG Assessment Precursors.

blurb.en: Failed short rains under borderline-weak La Niña conditions with a cool western Indian Ocean; severe pasture loss and acute livestock distress across the arid north.

impact_record.impact_class: Acute Pastoral Crisis & Rangeland Forage Collapse
impact_record.crop_stage_ond: Failure of 2005 OND Short Rains in Eastern and Coastal lowlands led to widespread germination failure and near-total crop loss for beans, cowpeas, and short-cycle maize.
impact_record.pasture_livestock: Pasture biomass collapsed across northern and eastern ASAL counties (Mandera, Wajir, Garissa, Marsabit); pastoral Terms of Trade plummeted as cattle and small stock prices collapsed relative to rising maize grain prices.
impact_record.flood_infrastructure: No riverine flooding; dried-up riverbeds and borehole drawdown forced pastoralists to trek livestock over 30 km daily to distant water points.
impact_record.disaster_response: Presidential Declaration of a National Disaster in December 2005; multi-agency response spearheaded by KFSSG and ALRMP (precursor to NDMA), providing commercial destocking subsidies and emergency school feeding.
impact_record.documentary_sources: KFSSG National Short Rains Assessment 2005/06; ALRMP Monthly Drought Monitoring Bulletins; UN OCHA Kenya Drought Situation Reports.

label.fr: Inondations El Niño et IOD positif de 2006

blurb.en: A late-developing El Niño combined with a strong positive Indian Ocean Dipole broke the 2005/06 drought with severe November–December riverine floods across the east and north.

impact_record.impact_class: Severe Flash Flooding & Rapid Pasture Flush
impact_record.crop_stage_ond: Intense October–November deluges caused localized soil waterlogging in lowland farms while providing abundant moisture for late-planted cereals across the southeastern marginal agricultural zone.
impact_record.pasture_livestock: Dramatic reversal of the 2005/06 drought with rapid rangeland greening, but rapid onset of vector-borne livestock diseases including Rift Valley Fever (RVF) quarantines declared in Garissa and Ijara.
impact_record.flood_infrastructure: High-discharge riverine flooding along Tana and Sabaki basins; Mandera town inundation from Daua River; road washouts along the B9 Garissa–Wajir road corridor.
impact_record.disaster_response: Emergency flood response and livestock ring-vaccination campaigns coordinated by the Ministry of Health, Directorate of Veterinary Services, and KRCS; distribution of treated mosquito nets and water purifiers.
impact_record.documentary_sources: Kenya Meteorological Department (KMD) Post-Season Evaluation 2006; KFSSG Post-Drought Recovery Assessment; WHO/FAO RVF Outbreak Briefings.

label.fr: Sécheresse de la Corne de l'Afrique de 2010-2011

blurb.en: Back-to-back failed rainy seasons under La Niña — one of the region's worst droughts in modern history, with famine declared across parts of the Horn of Africa.

impact_record.crop_stage_ond: Failed 2010 Short Rains followed by dismal 2011 Long Rains caused consecutive crop collapses across Kitui, Makueni, Tharaka Nithi, and Kwale; national maize reserves dropped to precarious thresholds.
impact_record.pasture_livestock: Total devastation of pastoral rangelands across Turkana, Marsabit, Isiolo, and Wajir; massive livestock mortality; pastoralist purchasing power crashed below the 25 kg/goat emergency collapse threshold.
impact_record.flood_infrastructure: Severe hydrological drought; water table drawdown; complete drying of seasonal laggas, earth pans, and shallow wells.
impact_record.disaster_response: Launch of the 'Kenyans for Kenya' national emergency initiative; massive humanitarian scale-up under KFSSG, NDMA, and UN agencies reaching 3.75 million food-insecure individuals with cash transfers and blanket supplementary feeding.
impact_record.documentary_sources: KFSSG Long Rains Assessment (LRA) 2011; NDMA National Drought Early Warning Bulletins; UN OCHA Horn of Africa Crisis Appeal.

blurb.en: A top-tier Pacific El Niño with high oceanic warmth driving enhanced short rains, localized flooding, and broad rangeland regeneration across Kenya.

impact_record.impact_class: Elevated Fluvial Flood Risk & Mixed Agricultural Bumper
impact_record.crop_stage_ond: Heavy OND rains created excellent planting and establishment conditions across Eastern Kenya (producing above-average short-rains pulse yields), while Western Kenya experienced localized maize harvesting delays.
impact_record.pasture_livestock: Excellent rangeland forage regeneration across all 23 ASAL counties; significant replenishment of water pans, dams, and strategic boreholes; high livestock milk yields and herd rebuilding.
impact_record.flood_infrastructure: Flash flooding and riverine surges along the Nyando, Tana, and Daua basins; localized mudslides on the Murang'a and Elgeyo-Marakwet escarpments; culvert washouts on county feeder roads.
impact_record.disaster_response: National El Niño Preparedness Taskforce activated contingency funds; pre-positioning of medical supplies, evacuation boats, and water treatment chemicals by NDOC, NDMA, and County Emergency Committees.
impact_record.documentary_sources: National El Niño Contingency Plan 2015; KFSSG Short Rains Assessment (SRA) 2015/16; NDMA Monthly Early Warning Bulletins.

blurb.en: Failed short rains under a weak La Niña with a cool western Indian Ocean, followed by poor long rains — prompting a formal national drought emergency declaration.

impact_record.impact_class: National Drought Emergency & Acute Forage Deficit
impact_record.crop_stage_ond: Failure of the 2016 Short Rains followed by late and erratic 2017 Long Rains devastated rain-fed agriculture in southeastern marginal counties and suppressed national maize production by 20–30%.
impact_record.pasture_livestock: Severe vegetative forage deficit across northern and coastal rangelands; cattle and sheep body conditions deteriorated to emaciation; pasture trekking distances surged beyond 15–25 km.
impact_record.flood_infrastructure: Complete absence of flood hazards; widespread drying of surface water sources and borehole mechanical breakdowns due to 24-hour over-pumping.
impact_record.disaster_response: National Drought Emergency declared by the President in February 2017; activation of the National Drought Emergency Fund and Hunger Safety Net Programme (HSNP) emergency scalable cash transfers in Marsabit, Mandera, Wajir, and Turkana.
impact_record.documentary_sources: KFSSG Short Rains Assessment 2016/17; NDMA National Drought Status Reports 2017; UN OCHA Flash Appeal.

label.fr: Inondations d'IOD positif et invasion acridienne de 2019

blurb.en: An exceptionally positive Indian Ocean Dipole — without a strong El Niño — brought extreme short rains, floods, landslides, and in their wake, the desert-locust upsurge.

impact_record.impact_class: Record Fluvial Floods, Escarpment Landslides & Desert Locust Upsurge
impact_record.crop_stage_ond: Torrential OND precipitation caused severe harvest losses for standing long-rains maize in Western Kenya (high moisture, mold, and post-harvest rot), while low-lying fields in the East suffered seedling washouts.
impact_record.pasture_livestock: Spectacular pasture greening across the northern rangelands, but extreme soil moisture created the primary breeding grounds for the 2019/20 Desert Locust upsurge (Schistocerca gregaria) that devastated vegetative cover months later.
impact_record.flood_infrastructure: Severe, widespread riverine flooding across Nzoia, Nyando, Tana, Daua, and Ewaso Ng'iro rivers; fatal landslides in West Pokot (Chesegon/Weiwei) and Murang'a; A2 highway severed at Merille and Milgis laggas; endorheic Chalbi pan submerged under an expansive inland sea isolating Kalacha and North Horr.
impact_record.disaster_response: Multi-agency emergency operations coordinated by NDOC, NDMA, and County Disaster Teams; deployment of military helicopters for stranded communities; launch of the FAO/Government desert locust aerial spraying campaign.
impact_record.documentary_sources: KFSSG Short Rains Assessment (SRA) 2019/20; NDMA Flood Impact Bulletins; FAO Desert Locust Emergency Dispatches.

blurb.en: Three consecutive La Niña years — five failed rainy seasons in a row. Pasture and harvests collapsed across the arid and semi-arid counties in Kenya's longest drought in modern records.

impact_record.crop_stage_ond: Five consecutive failed rainy seasons caused cumulative, near-total harvest failures across rain-fed cropping belts; marginal agricultural zones recorded five consecutive seasons of zero-to-negligible grain production.
impact_record.pasture_livestock: Catastrophic collapse of pastoral rangeland ecology; over 2.6 million livestock perished from starvation and dehydration across 23 ASAL counties; Terms of Trade plunged to record historic lows (below 15–20 kg/goat in Marsabit and Turkana); severe acute malnutrition rates exceeded WHO emergency thresholds.
impact_record.flood_infrastructure: Persistent absence of surface runoff; catastrophic drop in groundwater tables; strategic boreholes dried up or suffered salinity intrusion.
impact_record.disaster_response: National Drought Emergency declared September 2021; government and donor scale-up under NDMA, HSNP emergency shock-responsive transfers, livestock feed supplementation, emergency water trucking, and nationwide food distribution reaching 4.4 million severely food-insecure citizens.
impact_record.documentary_sources: KFSSG Long Rains Assessment (LRA) 2022; NDMA 2020–2023 Multi-Season Drought Review; IPC Acute Food Insecurity Reports 2021–2023.

label.fr: Super El Niño et IOD positif de 2023-2024

blurb.en: Strong El Niño combined with a positive Indian Ocean Dipole terminated the multi-year drought with torrential short rains, extensive riverine flooding, and rapid rangeland recovery.

impact_record.impact_class: Super El Niño Fluvial Deluges, Massive Inundation & Drought Break
impact_record.crop_stage_ond: Extremely heavy OND rainfall terminated the multi-year drought with torrential force. In Western Kenya, continuous rainfall hampered late harvesting of long-rains maize and raised aflatoxin risks. In Eastern and Coastal rangelands, torrential runoff eroded topsoil and submerged riverbank plots, but established exceptional residual soil moisture that enabled bumper 2024 harvests.
impact_record.pasture_livestock: Dramatic recovery of rangeland forage biomass across northern pastoral counties; rapid regeneration of perennial grass species and acacia browse; livestock body condition rebounded, but high small stock mortality occurred in early weeks from hypothermia, pneumonia, and flash floods.
impact_record.flood_infrastructure: Catastrophic riverine overflows: Tana River flooded Garissa, Madogo, and Hola; Daua River flooded Mandera town; Nyando and Nzoia rivers submerged Kano Plains and Budalang'i; Chalbi Desert became a 2,100+ km² seasonal lake isolating North Horr and Kalacha; Merille and Milgis laggas washed out A2 Trans-African highway bridge approaches, completely paralyzing freight between Kenya and Ethiopia.
impact_record.disaster_response: National Emergency Operation Center activated; Kenya Defence Forces (KDF) and KRCS deployed boats and helicopters for air-drops and rescue missions; NDMA coordinated county emergency non-food relief distributions and anticipatory cash transfers; KMD provided daily county-level flood advisories.
impact_record.documentary_sources: KFSSG National Short Rains Assessment (SRA) 2023/24; NDMA Monthly Early Warning Bulletins; KMD 2023 El Niño Post-Event Review; UN OCHA Kenya Flood Dispatches.
